title: The Well-Oath of Dune
summary: Caravan masters and badland herders between Dune, Orcrest, and Riverhold face a water-tally crisis when desert raiders defile the Two-Moons ridge temples and choke the qanat wells.

hook.rumour: Caravans halting at Dune say the deep qanat cisterns along the Orcrest road are running dry while armed outriders divert the night-water toward a sealed ridge temple.
hook.notice: CLAN-COURT OF DUNE: Trackers and caravan-guards wanted to inspect the badland qanat shafts between Dune, Orcrest, and Riverhold.

npcs.name: Warden of Dune
npcs.greet: Caravans halting at Dune say the deep qanat cisterns along the Orcrest road are running dry while armed outriders divert the night-water toward a sealed ridge temple.
talk: The trouble across Anequina began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Dune.
If you mean to help the Well-Clans of Anequina, start by checking the trail between Dune and Shrine to Lorkhaj.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Dune
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Shrine to Lorkhaj is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Shrine to Lorkhaj toward Dakheset Outpost before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Dune so Clan-Mother Ahzirr can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Dakheset Outpost
npcs.greet: You made good time from Shrine to Lorkhaj. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Defense Force Outpost.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Defense Force Outpost with a picked guard.
Once Defense Force Outpost is cleared, return to Dune to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Dune
npcs.greet: Clan-Mother Ahzirr awaits word on whether the crisis in Anequina has been contained.
talk: The elders of Dune have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Anequina owes you a debt for standing between Dune and ruin.
